result.headline: No clear control fault found; roll tracks its setpoint, pitch looks sign-inverted, airspeed is flat zero, and start-up warnings appear.
result.explanation: Roll follows its setpoint with a lag. Pitch follows its setpoint with inverted sign, probably a frame or logging convention. Low-voltage and sensor-health warnings at t=0.578 s are the earliest signs, but nothing shows what they affect.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.578 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: Earliest sign, before any signal moves. The data cannot show whether it is real or a start-up artifact.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.578 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: Sensor-health error at the same instant as the battery warning. It does not name the sensor.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT vehicle.airspeed = 0 for the whole recording (2446 samples)
evidence.shows: Airspeed is flat zero for the whole flight while the vehicle moves. The airspeed sensor is dead or not logged.

evidence.quote: TRACKING control.attitude_setpoint[roll] vs vehicle.attitude[roll]: typical |error| 6.032 deg, worst 57.179 at t=180.659 s; 6 window(s) above 18.095
evidence.shows: Roll correlation is 0.983 at 0.979 s lag, so the roll loop follows its command with delay.

evidence.quote: TRACKING control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] vs vehicle.attitude[pitch]: typical |error| 7.591 deg, worst 49.908 at t=204.125 s; 6 window(s) above 22.774
evidence.shows: Pitch correlation is -0.941 at 1.714 s lag. Pitch follows the setpoint with inverted sign, so either a convention mismatch or an inverted pitch path.

checked.check: Sequence of signals leaving baseline in the first 20 s
checked.result: No signal left its baseline first. Only the two start-up events at 0.578 s are listed.
Correlation 0.791 at zero lag, 0.983 at 0.979 s lag. Typical error 6.032 deg, worst 57.179 deg at t=180.659 s.
Correlation -0.508 at zero lag, -0.941 at 1.714 s lag, so the sign is inverted.
checked.about: Frame or sign convention or inverted pitch path

checked.check: Actuator outputs, throttle and attitude over 0-40 s
checked.result: ch2 ranges 1100 to 1700 us while throttle ranges 0 to 75 %. Roll ranges from -32.074 to 51.305 deg in this window.
ch0, ch6, ch7, airspeed and yaw_rate are constant for the whole recording.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.attitude[yaw] at t=12.673 s: 120.676 -> 8.132 deg (step -112.544, 118.9x its usual variation)
effects.why: Similar yaw steps recur at lines 61 and 62. This looks like repeated circling or mission legs, not a fault.

effects.quote: CHANGE vehicle.altitude[relative] at t=5.672 s: 82.223 -> 51.118 m (step -31.105, 111.9x its usual variation)
effects.why: Altitude drop at the start of the flight, following the throttle and attitude command changes. It shows a manoeuvre, not a cause.

next_action.action: Check attitude frame convention and airspeed sensor configuration for this flight
next_action.why: Separates a logging sign convention from a real pitch control inversion, and shows whether the airspeed and battery warnings are real.
how: Read the setpoint and attitude topic frame conventions (ENU/NED) in the logging config
Check the airspeed sensor enable parameter and pitot wiring
Read cell voltage on the ground against the low-voltage threshold
next_action.baseline: Roll, where setpoint and attitude agree in sign at 0.979 s lag (call cc_7).

outcomes.label: Setpoint and attitude frames differ in sign
outcomes.means: The pitch inversion is a logging artifact, so no pitch control fault is shown.
outcomes.then: Focus on airspeed and battery warnings.

outcomes.label: Frames match, pitch still inverted
outcomes.means: A real pitch path inversion or mis-set control surface direction.
outcomes.then: Request actuator mapping and a normal-flight log.

unknowns: Whether the low-voltage and sensor-health warnings are real or a start-up artifact.
Whether the pitch inversion is a logging convention or a control inversion.
Why airspeed and yaw_rate are constant zero.

hypotheses.claim: Pitch setpoint and attitude use opposite sign conventions, so their tracking error is an artifact.
hypotheses.because: Pitch correlation is -0.941 at 1.714 s lag, while roll correlates at 0.983.

hypotheses.claim: The airspeed sensor is dead or unlogged and the sensor-health error is real.
hypotheses.because: Airspeed is 0 for 2446 samples and the sensor-health error appears at t=0.578 s.

hypotheses.claim: Low battery voltage is real and affects motor or servo output.
hypotheses.because: Warning at t=0.578 s, but no voltage signal is recorded to check it.

hypotheses.claim: The actuator outputs or servos oscillate with large commanded swings.
hypotheses.because: ch2 ranges 1100 to 1700 us with throttle and roll swings. This looks commanded, not faulty.

hypotheses.claim: The pitch controller or its surface direction is inverted.
hypotheses.because: A -0.941 correlation could also be a convention artifact, and roll behaves normally.

events.what: Low-voltage warning and sensor-health error at start-up
events.why: Earliest sign, but the data does not show what it affects.
Follow commanded setpoint and throttle changes.
Repeated circling or mission legs, not a fault.

events.what: Pitch and roll divergence windows from setpoint
events.why: Follow fast setpoint swings and loop lag.
